The decision followed allegations that Sylvia leaked classified information about Iran and Ukraine to the media, as reported by Al Jazeera and Die Welt.

Pakistan’s military spokesman said the country is cautiously optimistic about US–Iran mediation, according to the Jerusalem Post and Al Jazeera. The statement came amid growing diplomatic activity between Washington and Tehran.

A Treasury Department report released Friday says Iran’s economy is cratering and inflation is 90%, according to The Hill and Axios. The report notes that U.S. sanctions and blockade are crippling Iran’s economy.
The United States has approved a sale of Patriot missiles to Ukraine, according to The Hill and the Kyiv Post. This move follows earlier discussions about military options against Iran.
